description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 17th May 2021 to 23.05.2021
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new exchange rates for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It is a regulatory instrument issued by the Director General of Customs to determine how customs calculations will be performed, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organisational, land, commercial, or other specialized category.
